title: yencoding: YencMetadata/DecodedPart/EncodePartOptions missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: P1: All three public output/options structs lack #[non_exhaustive]. Adding any field is a semver break. Also EncodePartOptions lacks Debug+Clone.
close_reason: Added #[derive(Debug, Clone)] to EncodePartOptions. Skipped #[non_exhaustive] on YencMetadata/DecodedPart/EncodePartOptions: all three have external struct-literal construction sites (yencoding-multi assembler, integration tests, mime-tree sentinel). Adding non_exhaustive would require constructors — deferred to 0.2.0 API cleanup.
